description: Source code for a JSON writer utility, implementing functions to build JSON objects and arrays with optional pretty printing, including string escaping, indentation, and nested structure handling.

methods.name: append_quoted_string
methods.description: Escapes special characters and appends a JSON-quoted string to the output buffer.

methods.name: indent_pretty
methods.description: Adds indentation spaces based on the current open stack length for pretty printing.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts a JSON object or array, updating the open stack and formatting.

methods.name: assert_in_object
methods.description: Checks that the current open stack top is an object, triggers BUG if not.

methods.name: assert_in_array
methods.description: Checks that the current open stack top is an array, triggers BUG if not.

methods.name: maybe_add_comma
methods.description: Adds a comma if a previous element has been added at the current level.

methods.name: fmt_double
methods.description: Formats a double value with specified precision into JSON.

methods.name: object_common
methods.description: Prepares JSON object key-value pair, handling commas and indentation.

methods.name: array_common
methods.description: Prepares JSON array element, handling commas and indentation.

methods.name: assert_is_terminated
methods.description: Ensures the current JSON structure is properly closed.

methods.name: append_sub_jw
methods.description: Appends a nested JSON writer object, adjusting indentation based on 'pretty' settings.

methods.name: increase_indent
methods.description: Increases indentation of a JSON string for pretty printing.

methods.name: kill_indent
methods.description: Removes indentation from a JSON string to convert to compact form.
